Paper_Title: Study of the plastic deformation mechanism of TRIP–TWIP high entropy alloys at the atomic level
Initial_Atom_Assignment: Atoms randomly assigned in an FCC crystal according to alloy molar ratio before melt/quench
Potential_References: Zhou et al. + Anand et al. parameter sets
Energy_Minimization: Conjugate-gradient relaxation; energy tolerance 1e-15; force tolerance 1.6e-24 N
Subsequent_Ensembles: NVT and NVE after NPT relaxation to ensure metastable structure
Notes: The paper is computational. Its 12 tensile cases are MD conditions, not experimental specimens or experimental ML samples.
